questions.question: How did Elihu say God speaks to people?
options: In dreams, visions, and through suffering
Only through his own specially appointed prophets
Not at all, leaving men in silence
Only through the words of kings
questions.answer: In dreams, visions, and through suffering

questions.question: What did Elihu say a mediator/angel may do for a man?
options: Condemn the man outright for his hidden sins
Be gracious and find a ransom to deliver him
Turn fully away and ignore all of his cries
Punish him far beyond what he ever deserved
questions.answer: Be gracious and find a ransom to deliver him

questions.question: Elihu invited Job to answer him if he could.
Elihu said God's purpose in these warnings is to turn a man back from the _____.
Elihu said he too was formed from a piece of _____, like Job.
